items.title: McDonald's and Qualcomm earnings, ADP labor data: What to Watch
items.summary: Market Domination Overtime Host Jake Conley previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Wednesday, November 4, including earnings out from Qualcomm (QCOM), McDonald's (MCD), and DoorDash (DASH), as well as the latest employment data out from ADP.

items.title: Trump’s FTC Turns to DoorDash’s Pricing and Dasher Pay After the Instacart Deal
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOn Oct. 28, the FTC ordered DoorDash, Instacart, Walmart and six other companies to explain whether they use personal data to set prices and gig-worker pay, a day before DoorDash agreed to buy Instacart for about $17 billion.

items.title: DoorDash Delivers Strong Q3 FCF, and DASH Rises After Its InstaCart Takeover Bid
items.summary: DoorDash confirmed it will offer $65 in cash (75%) and stock to buy Instacart, and also delivered strong Q3 FCF. As a result, DASH stock is up as of Oct. 26 ahead of the Oct. 27 pre-market announcement.

items.title: Early Uber Investor: Tesla and Uber Will “Split 80%” of the Robotaxi Market
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEarly Uber investor Jason Calacanis bought 15,000 Uber shares at $65 with a $120 target, and he expects Tesla to take 40% of the autonomous vehicle market, Uber 35% and Alphabet’s Waymo 15%. Uber’s market value is now about the same as Waymo’s private valuation, which looks too gloomy for a company making about $10 billion a year in free cash flow.
